caption: The drawing shows a rectangular textile panel with a light blue-green background. It is bordered on both longer sides by a scalloped edge decorated with a floral motif of green vines and small yellow, blue, and purple flowers. Within the main area of the panel, there are clusters of flowers spaced vertically along the length. These clusters include large pink roses with green leaves, purple flowers, small blue flowers, and additional smaller white and yellow blossoms. The background features soft, cloud-like washes of blue and pale green, with some areas of lavender and white, giving a watercolor effect. The overall composition is symmetrical along the central vertical axis, and the floral arrangement appears to flow diagonally from the bottom left to the top right.
